reason: Reads the error classes Playwright exports on its package object. Strider's failures are typed errors matched by their reason, such as Deadline.Timeout, and it has no such export to check
Reads Playwright's table of device descriptors, such as iPhone 6 and its default browser type. Strider has no device table
Passes Playwright's internal test hooks to the launch, which stall its graceful close. Strider's launch takes no such hooks

Launches a headed browser with no X server, by removing DISPLAY from the browser's environment, and expects Playwright's message about xvfb-run. Strider has no per-launch environment to remove DISPLAY from, and its message is its own
